verdict.rationale: SumUp exposes webhooks for status-change notifications, an MCP server, and an Agent Toolkit for building agentic integrations (LangChain, AI SDK, OpenAI Agents SDK), which are the building blocks an AI-native user could use to construct background automations, but there is no evidence of an actual autonomous scheduling/automation-running feature within SumUp itself. Missing for 10: documented autonomous/scheduled automation execution, persistence of agent state, or a hands-on example of an agent running unattended in the background using these tools.
